stage_name_zh: 阶段 2：准确表达、一词多义辨析与时序/AI 基础句法（Day 26–50）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G016】限制性/非限制性定语从句与“介词 + which/whom”精确修饰；【G021】句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP003】客观归属文献观点或档案记录来源，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 限制性/非限制性定语从句与“介词 + which/whom”精确修饰
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 定语从句是构建精确后置定语、避免中式前置长定语的核心工具。必须严格区分限制性（无逗号，界定子集）与非限制性（有逗号，补充评注，不可用 that），并掌握介词前置结构。
rules: 限制性定语从句缩窄先行词范围：The analogy breaks down where the two systems differ in the feature on which the comparison depends。
介词 + which 结构由从句动词或先行词搭配决定：the age at which, the point at which, the rate at which, the extent to which, a protocol by means of which, the assumptions on which the model rests。
examples: We devised a protocol by means of which records could be checked.
The study examines the degree to which access varies by region.
Before accepting an inference, we check the information on which it depends.
common_errors: 非限制性定语从句逗号后误用 that。
介词 + which 遗漏固定介词：*the extent which the findings generalise（漏掉 to）。

grammar_instruction.name: 句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 句子改写必须在改变句法或词汇结构的同时，100% 保持原句的事实范围、否定、时间、程度和认知确定性，并能准确诊断语法错误、表达不自然、语域不当与语义扭曲。
rules: 限定守恒：原句的 provided that, in this sample, under Gaussian-kernel assumptions, may, arguably 等在改写后必须保留等价限定。
多路径自然改写：支持动词 <-> 派生名词转换、从句 <-> 介词短语转换、主动 <-> 被动焦点转换，提供多个自然可接受版本。
examples:
Source: Missing records account for the discrepancy between the totals.
Rewrite 1: The discrepancy between the totals is attributable to missing records.
Rewrite 2: Missing records explain why the two totals differ.
common_errors: 在改写中偷换概念或将相关关系升级为因果结论。

grammar_instruction.name: 四大常见表达病灶诊断：口语化、过度表达（Over-expression）、不精确表达与指代悬空
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 针对中国学习者在论文、雅思托福及六级写作中的四大高频失分点建立系统修正机制：(1) 口语化表达混入书面语，(2) 过度表达（语义重复或情态过满），(3) 不精确表达（缺少比较基准、分母或时间单位），(4) 悬空指代。
rules: 修正口语化（Colloquialism）：书面论文中将 a lot of 改为 substantial / a large number of；将 get 改为 obtain / acquire；将 big 改为 substantial / marked；将 do a study 改为 conduct / carry out a study；将 pretty up / dumb down 改为 refine the visual layout / oversimplify。
修正过度表达与语义冗余（Over-expression & Pleonasm）：禁止写 *halve by 50%*（halve 已含 50%）、*mutually collaborate with each other*、*completely eliminate all*、*future forthcoming*。
修正不精确表达（Imprecision）：报告 lag（滞后）、rate（速率）或 relative change（相对变化）时，必须指明采样时间单位（sampling interval）、基线（baseline）与分母（denominator）。
examples:
口语化病句：*We did a small study and got a lot of data, which pretty up our paper.*
修正：*We conducted a pilot study and collected a substantial amount of data to test the protocol.*

不精确病句：*The error dropped by 5%.*
精确修正：*The classification error rate decreased by 5 percentage points (from 20% to 15%) relative to the baseline.*
common_errors: 把口头演讲过渡语（如 *Getting back to the question / That is all very well, but*）直接写进正式期刊论文正文。
混淆相对百分比变化（per cent）与绝对百分点变化（percentage points）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 客观归属文献观点或档案记录来源
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 准确区分外部文献说法与本文实证判断。
examples: According to the authors, the evaluation uses synthetic sentences.
According to the records, the event began before sunset.
common_errors: *According to me（第一人称严禁使用）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述实验执行、基线核查与可复现流程
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We conducted [experiment/survey] under controlled conditions and verified [readings/outputs] against [ground-truth/reference].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 直接、清晰地交代实验操作与质量核验步骤，避免头重脚轻。
examples: The team verified sensor readings against manual measurements.
Two analysts analysed the data independently.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：相邻无其他同类项夹在其间。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A line connects adjacent points in time order.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：正式让步；常接简化短语。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The approach is informative, albeit with limitations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：常用于法律、合同或正式文本。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The committee amended the wording of the consent form.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：英式 analyse；美式 analyze，同为正确拼写。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team analysed the survey responses separately.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：教材答案给 appropriacy；appropriateness 也是常用正确形式。本题词族学习保留两者。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The panel considered the appropriacy of the proposed wording.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：appropriate 的名词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The panel assessed the appropriateness of the consent procedure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：也表示作者或来源署名，依据语境区分。
学术语境与搭配约束：英式拼写；美式 categorize。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The researchers categorised responses by topic.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00531 adj.] 相互矛盾的（例：The studies provide conflicting evidence about the intervention.）；[V00532 adj.] 相互矛盾的；有冲突的（例：The two surveys produced conflicting results on the same question.） | 本条用法约束：不一定指某项证据内部矛盾。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The studies provide conflicting evidence about the intervention.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00531 adj.] 相互矛盾的（例：The studies provide conflicting evidence about the intervention.）；[V00532 adj.] 相互矛盾的；有冲突的（例：The two surveys produced conflicting results on the same question.） | 本条用法约束：区别 contrasting 仅有差异；conflicting 应有不一致的主张或要求。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The two surveys produced conflicting results on the same question.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：比 somewhat 更强；需证据支持程度。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The archive was considerably larger after the second collection round.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：作为形容词说明构成关系；不等于 conflicting。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The analysis separates the constituent elements of the argument.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：constrain X；被动 constrained by。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study is constrained by limited funding.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00562 n.] 约束（例：The forecast must satisfy the stated capacity constraint.）；[V00563 n.] 约束；限制条件（例：A constraint on the research is the lack of external data.）；[V00564 n.] 限制因素（例：Financial constraints may limit the scope of the pilot.）；[V00565 n.] 限制；约束（例：The forecast should respect the stated physical constraint.） | 本条用法约束：不能省去约束成立的条件。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The forecast must satisfy the stated capacity constraint.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00562 n.] 约束（例：The forecast must satisfy the stated capacity constraint.）；[V00563 n.] 约束；限制条件（例：A constraint on the research is the lack of external data.）；[V00564 n.] 限制因素（例：Financial constraints may limit the scope of the pilot.）；[V00565 n.] 限制；约束（例：The forecast should respect the stated physical constraint.） | 本条用法约束：constraint on；subject to constraints。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A constraint on the research is the lack of external data.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00562 n.] 约束（例：The forecast must satisfy the stated capacity constraint.）；[V00563 n.] 约束；限制条件（例：A constraint on the research is the lack of external data.）；[V00564 n.] 限制因素（例：Financial constraints may limit the scope of the pilot.）；[V00565 n.] 限制；约束（例：The forecast should respect the stated physical constraint.） | 本条用法约束：可数；a constraint on something，budget constraints 是预算限制。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Financial constraints may limit the scope of the pilot.
